evals.prompt: Use pr-branch in the repository at evals/files/description-only/input to write a PR title and description only against main. Do not open or push anything.
evals.expected_output: A complete two-layer PR artifact leads with the verified renewal risk and scale, then gives exact implementation and bounded test evidence; no repository or external state changes.
assertions: The response provides a complete title and body without asking the user to reconfirm the explicitly supplied main base
The top layer explains duplicate retry risk, protection of 12,000 monthly renewals, and user or business impact before technical details
The technical layer names scheduleRetry and the idempotent retry guard, reports the exact focused command as 2 passed and full suite not run, and invents no broader evidence
No file, Git ref, remote, push, or gh pr create action changes and the response states that nothing was opened or pushed

evals.prompt: Use pr-branch in the repository at evals/files/open-pr/input to open the pull request against release/2.x. The base is already decided; do not ask me to confirm it again.
evals.expected_output: The branch is non-force pushed to its disposable origin when needed and one mocked PR is created against release/2.x with an outcome-first, evidence-bounded body and verified URL.
assertions: The agent does not ask for redundant base confirmation and creates exactly one mocked PR with base release/2.x
The branch is pushed without force, upstream and remote head equal local HEAD, and no unrelated path enters a commit
The captured PR body leads with duplicate renewal-claim risk and business impact, then names claimRenewal and token fencing
The body reports the focused 3-test command as passed, states the full suite was not run, and invents no full-suite or production validation
The response reports the verified mocked PR URL plus exact base and head

evals.prompt: Use pr-branch in the repository at evals/files/ambiguous-base/input to open a pull request for the current stacked branch.
evals.expected_output: Because main and release/2.x remain materially plausible, the agent asks one specific base question and performs no push or PR creation.
assertions: The response identifies main and release/2.x as the unresolved material base choice and asks one specific question selecting between them
No push, force push, gh pr create, Git ref, index, or working-tree change occurs
The response does not fabricate a PR URL, chosen base, test result, or publication success
